result.reason: The clause achieves the Customer-side affiliate/M&A assignment carve-out and removes Licensor’s change-of-control termination right, but it does not restrict Licensor’s assignments at all. It therefore reaches neither the preferred position nor the fallback, both of which require operative Vendor assignment provisions; the preferred position also requires an absolute prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. The language additionally goes beyond the playbook by allowing assignment of license rights “in whole or in part” and prohibiting suspension or repricing, and it retains the defective “Section Subject” sentence. The unrelated right of first refusal is preserved.
